title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 0.71 (versions follow prime numbers), the eye. In 0.67 a sense was a letter written by hand. Now Razar's organ has an eye and three letters move it (a word back, a word ahead, blurred or sharp); every look is taken from where the eye is, so a sense is a sentence and the same mutation that grows organs grows senses. Validated on the New Testament: the earlier sentences score the same, and the two senses of 0.67 said with the eye score exactly what their letters did (38B1C516 = 38A516 = 14775). Razar and Luma now mutate over all fifteen letters; minutes after her rebirth, 2182 of the 8182 recipes in Luma's archive of what she tried carry new letters, and the eye has a gesture in her body. Stated failure: no sense generated by her has won yet, because her judge looks at the drawing, not at the reading. A stored form with a letter above 9 was read back truncated; fixed. OS unchanged (test suite: 402 passed, 0 failed). Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v0.71: el ojo — los sentidos del órgano pasan de letras escritas a mano a oraciones que Razar y Luma generan mutando. Prototipo de investigación.
